name.baseName: Processing of particleboard/MDF panel by Computerized Numerical Control machine

dataSetInformation.common:synonyms: Lavorazione di pannelli di truciolare e MDF laminati utilizzando un centro di lavoro a controllo numerico (CNC), presso l’utilizzatore
dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Dataset developed according to Arcadia project Methodology (Report: “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA”). LCA study of processing of laminated chipboard and MDF panels using a Computerized Numerical Control (CNC) machine: " STUDIO LCA DELLA FASE DI LAVORAZIONE DI PANNELLI A BASE LEGNO PER MEZZO DI UN CENTRO DI LAVORO A CONTROLLO NUMERICO”. The dataset refers to the processing of laminated chipboard and MDF panels using a Computerized Numerical Control (CNC) machine and is representative of the mid-top range of the technologies commonly used for the processing of wood based materials.

referenceToExternalDocumentation.common:shortDescription: Background datasets from Ecoinvent database cut-off (v.3.7.1) were used for the LCA study

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Italy. Primary data collected in Marche region. Dataset representative of Italian processing of laminated chipboard and MDF panels using a Computerized Numerical Control (CNC) machine

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: Processing of laminated chipboard and MDF panels with a weight of 4941 g (average weight between the laminated MDF panel (5098 g) and the laminated chipboard panel (4783 g)). The size of the laminated chipboard is 605x605X18mm and its density is 770kg/m³ ; the size of the MDF panel is 700x550X18mm and its density is 710kg/m³. The process involves the processing, of the panel which undergoes a series of operations: milling, drilling and cutting, in order to obtain a semi-finished product. The machine uses electricity for the processing and wood dust and scraps are generated as waste flow. The electricity consumption for the processing of the panel is 256,5 Wh. Both the production of the panel entering the machine and the management of waste products are excluded from the system boundaries. The wood waste deriving from the panel processing (including the dust extracted from the hoods) is classified as non-hazardous recovery waste and can be used for the production of wood particleboard or energy recovery. Background data were modelled according to Ecoinvent v. 3.7.1
technology.technologicalApplicability: The processing of laminated chipboard and MDF panels can be used for all types of wood furniture
